endpoints.summary: Submit a single protein-ligand docking job.  Poll /api/jobs/<id>.
endpoints.description: Submit a single protein-ligand docking job.  Poll /api/jobs/<id>.

request_fields.name: protein_uri
request_fields.description: URI reference to a PDB file (scheme in {job, oss, file, http(s)}).  Mutex with ``protein`` upload and ``protein_sequence``.

request_fields.name: protein_sequence
request_fields.description: Protein amino-acid sequence (single chain, or multi-chain separated by ``:``).  When present, upstream folds it with ESMFold v1 before docking (adds ~5 GB weight + ~30 s cold GPU warmup).  Mutex with ``protein`` upload and ``protein_uri``.

request_fields.name: ligand_uri
request_fields.description: URI reference to a ligand file (.sdf/.mol2).  Mutex with ``ligand`` upload and ``ligand_description``.

request_fields.name: ligand_description
request_fields.description: SMILES / SMARTS string parseable by RDKit.  Mutex with ``ligand`` upload and ``ligand_uri``.

request_fields.name: complex_name
request_fields.description: Output subdirectory name under output/.  Must match ``[A-Za-z0-9_-]+`` (no slashes / spaces / dots).

request_fields.name: samples_per_complex
request_fields.description: Number of reverse diffusion samples (paper peak = 40; 10 is a speed/precision trade).

request_fields.name: inference_steps
request_fields.description: Total denoise steps.

request_fields.name: actual_steps
request_fields.description: Actual denoise steps to run (early-stop; must be <= inference_steps).

request_fields.name: batch_size
request_fields.description: GPU batch size.  Reduce to 4 on OOM.

request_fields.name: no_final_step_noise
request_fields.description: Skip the final noise step.  NOTE: upstream is store_true default True — request value False is IGNORED in v0.0.1.  See design doc §Risks §4.

request_fields.name: save_visualisation
request_fields.description: Dump reverse-diffusion trajectory as PDB per rank (large output volume; debug only).

request_fields.name: seed
request_fields.description: Random seed; framework fills a stable value when None.
request_fields.default_note: random seed selected by the tool at runtime

examples.title: PDB + SDF file upload (default preset)
examples.curl: curl -X POST $URL/api/dock -F protein=@target.pdb -F ligand=@ligand.sdf -F complex_name=1a0q -F samples_per_complex=10 -F inference_steps=20
examples.notes: Fastest path when both structures are on hand.  Output: output/1a0q/rank1.sdf + confidence_scores.json.

examples.title: PDB + SMILES ligand
examples.notes: RDKit ETKDG generates seed conformer from SMILES.  For invalid SMILES the job fails with `no_outputs` (RDKit embedding failure).

examples.title: protein_sequence + SMILES (ESMFold pipeline)
examples.notes: ESMFold folds the sequence server-side (adds ~30 s on A10 for a 300 aa protein).  Requires esmfold_3B_v1.pt in the NAS ESM cache — check /healthz/detail.

examples.title: async task mode (recommended for GPU-heavy jobs)
examples.curl: curl -X POST $URL/api/tasks/dock -H "X-Fc-Invocation-Type: Async" -F protein=@target.pdb -F ligand=@ligand.sdf -F samples_per_complex=40 -F inference_steps=40
examples.notes: Client polls /api/jobs/<id> for final JobInfo.  Preferred over sync submit/poll on FC for jobs longer than ~2 min.

job_lifecycle.poll_recommendation: Poll the status endpoint every 5–120 s until status ∈ {'completed', 'failed'}. On failure, JobInfo.error_summary holds a one-line exception summary and error_tail holds the trailing ~4 KB of the subprocess log — usually enough for triage without a separate /log fetch.
job_lifecycle.restart_semantics: Jobs survive process and FC instance restarts via a `job.json` sidecar in each job directory. Jobs that were RUNNING at the moment of restart are downgraded to FAILED with failure_kind='interrupted'.

nas_layout.cross_instance_consistency: When multiple FC instances mount the same NAS at jobs_base_dir, all of them can see each other's jobs via read-through cache on GET. Writes (create/update) only happen on the instance that owns the subprocess.
nas_layout.cross_service_sharing: Other bioagent services mounted on the same NAS can read this service's output files directly by path, avoiding HTTP round-trips. Example: another service does `Path('/data/rfantibody_jobs/<id>/output/file.qv').read_bytes()`.

model.name: DiffDock-L (v1.1)
model.paper: Corso, Deng, Polizzi, Barzilay, Jaakkola. arXiv:2402.18396 (ICLR 2024).  Original: arXiv:2210.01776 (ICLR 2023).
model.task: small-molecule blind docking (score + confidence diffusion on T(3) × SO(3) × SO(2)^m)
model.note: Rigid protein (no torsion / side-chain flexibility). Ligand torsion is modeled.  ESM-2 embedding is required; ESMFold folding kicks in only when protein_sequence is provided instead of a PDB.

tool_outputs.dock: output/<complex_name>/rank<r>_confidence<c>.sdf for r in [1, samples_per_complex]; output/<complex_name>/rank1.sdf (top-1, unlabeled duplicate); output/<complex_name>/confidence_scores.json (parsed ranking); output/<complex_name>/<complex_name>_esmfold.pdb (only if protein_sequence input)

config_tips.samples_per_complex: 10 = default (fast); 40 = paper accuracy peak; >40 = marginal returns.
config_tips.inference_steps: 20 = default; 40 = paper max.  Higher = more denoise steps ~= slower + slightly better.
config_tips.actual_steps: Typically inference_steps - 1; the last step tends to overfit noise (upstream default 19 vs 20).
config_tips.batch_size: 10 fits T4 for typical protein 300 aa.  OOM => reduce to 4.
config_tips.no_final_step_noise: Requested value 'false' is IGNORED in v0.0.1 (upstream is store_true default True; no CLI to disable). See design doc §Risks §4.
config_tips.protein_sequence: Long sequences (>800 aa) may OOM on T4 during ESMFold.  Recommend A10 24GB or split into chains via ':'.
config_tips.ligand: SMILES needs a valid parseable structure; RDKit ETKDG generates seed conformer.  If RDKit fails to embed, upstream logs 'Failed on ...' and skips → detect_outputs returns false.
config_tips.async_payload_limit: FC async task mode (/api/tasks/dock) caps the request payload at 128 KiB.  A full protein PDB is almost always larger, so for /api/tasks/dock pass the protein via protein_uri (file:// on NAS, oss://, or job://) — NOT a multipart upload.  Sync /api/dock has no such cap and accepts multipart uploads directly.

input_uri_schemes.protein: multipart .pdb / job:// / oss:// / file:// / http(s):// / OR protein_sequence text field (str, → ESMFold)
input_uri_schemes.ligand: multipart .sdf/.mol2 / job:// / oss:// / file:// / http(s):// OR ligand_description text field (SMILES / SMARTS)

service_specific.chaining_tip: Common upstream pipelines: (a) RFantibody / genie3 designed PDB → diffdock-server /api/dock via `protein_uri=job://<prev>/target.pdb`; (b) ESMFold-driven end-to-end: pass protein_sequence directly, DiffDock folds internally.
